disable.title: Disable account
disable.warning: Only idle accounts can be disabled. Access stops immediately. The last usable Admin cannot be disabled.
disable.confirm: Disable this account? History is retained. This page cannot re-enable the account.
disable.pending: Checking the existing command. Do not submit again. Unknown outcomes retain local deny and quota reservations.

states.WAITING_EXTERNAL: Access denied; awaiting identity and SIP confirmation
states.REJECTED: Disable rejected; previous state restored only after verified proof
states.ACTION_REQUIRED: Outcome unknown. Access remains denied and quota reserved. Check the existing command.

errors.NOT_ACCEPTED: The command was not accepted because a service is not ready. Refresh before starting again.
errors.FAILED: Outcome not confirmed. Check the existing command; do not resubmit.
errors.LAST_USABLE_ADMIN: The last usable Admin cannot be disabled.
errors.CONFIG_BUSY: The user or affected queues have unfinished work. Complete that work first.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: Data changed. Refresh before submitting another command.
errors.PROTECTED_OR_FOREIGN_IDENTITY: This account is outside the permitted disable scope.

title: User accounts
attention: This account requires attention. Contact an administrator; it is not activated.
notice: Provisioning, invitation delivery and activation are separate states. Users set their own password/TOTP; activation does not open calls automatically.
notReady: Account provisioning is unavailable or you do not have permission to create accounts.
pending: The outcome is not yet confirmed. Check the original command before creating another account.
rejected: The command was rejected. The account is not activated.
name: Display name

directory.title: Accounts in this scope
directory.empty: No verified accounts in this scope
directory.unverified: Activation is not confirmed. Check provisioning status before use.
directory.failed: Accounts could not be loaded. Reload the list to try again.

errors.CREATE_REJECTED: The request was not accepted. Check the details or resources and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the name, email, role, team and extension before submitting again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Sign in again, then check the original command.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage accounts in this scope.
errors.FAILED: The outcome is not confirmed. Check the original command instead of creating a duplicate account.

invitation.title: Invitation and activation
invitation.pending: Checking the original command. Do not submit a duplicate.
invitation.failed: Outcome not confirmed. Check the original command before submitting again.
invitation.limited: The limit of 3 resends per rolling 60 minutes has been reached. Wait before trying again.
invitation.active: Account activated — calls are not opened automatically.
